description: Combined dataset coverage of the metallodrug vertical: PlatinAI_MBFinder (unconditional corpus) + MetalCytoToxDB (real IC50) + tmQM (QM-annotated metal-coordination). Coverage is the union of Pt/Pd/Au/Ir/Ru and cell-line activity labels available for Round-12+ de novo typed-term MCTS evaluation

MetalCytoToxDB.format: csv (23 cols incl IC50_Dark, IC50_Light, IC50_Cisplatin, Metal, Cell_line)
MetalCytoToxDB.ic50_label: IC50_Dark (μM cytotoxicity), IC50_Light (μM phototoxicity), IC50_Cisplatin (μM control)

tmQM_parsed.format: csv (18 cols incl metal, coord_number, HL_Gap, HOMO/LUMO, BO)
tmQM_parsed.bond_pattern_coverage: all 15 metals; coord_number dist dominated by CN=4 (Pt_II, 33%) and CN=6 (Pt_IV, 31%)

verdict: MEASURED via local dataset inventory — vertical coverage is dataset-derived (Phase 1), not model-derived. PlatinAI corpus (228K × 2) provides ML activity proxy; MetalCytoToxDB (26.8K) provides wet-lab IC50 across 8 cell lines; tmQM (108K) provides 15-metal QM-annotated coordination chemistry. Click-reaction coverage across all corpora is near-zero (<3.2% SPAAC max), confirming Lambda's 5-click typed reductions are de novo design not corpus replay.
honest_framing: Coverage numbers are CENSUS of local /mnt/storage/data/molmetal/ (Phase 1 audit, 2026-09-16). 3000-sample scan (random seed=0) for click/SMARTS/Lipinski stats; full-population scan expected within ±2pp for canonical_rate / Lipinski, noise floor ≤ 0.0003 for click coverage. NCI60_GI50 (sampled 200K of ~6M) is SMILES-less (NSC-keyed); included as reference only.
